source_direction.text: Close view of the exact long-snouted seahorse fountain in its established position. It looks sick and overgrown with seaweed and soft marine growth; a soggy pink wrapper/weed plug is unmistakably lodged in its mouth/nozzle. Roshan's concerned face enters at the edge without touching it. Locked camera. End with the pink obstruction fully readable. No different animal, trash beside the mouth, flowing clean water, frightening injury, or extraction. Sound: temporary weak watery cough and room ambience; no voices.
